en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: I asked Abu Abdullah (as): I give a man twenty dinars and say to him, "If your fruit reaches a certain value, it is mine for that price. If I agree, I will take it, and if I dislike it, I will leave it."
Imam (as) said: "Can you not give it to him without making any condition?"
I said: May I be your ransom! What if he does not specify anything, but Allah (swt) knows his intention?
Imam (as) said: "It is not permissible if that is his intention."
